budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Carry or relay four expiring packets to their privately assigned opposite-side depots through three shared openings.
task.natural_termination: All four packets have been delivered or expired; otherwise truncate at 64 nonterminal steps.
task.interaction: A consenting adjacent handoff transfers the sole packet slot and its destination information. Broadcast single-cell reservations deny entry to other roles for a bounded duration. Conservative simultaneous collision rules prevent swaps and create congestion. Packet sponsorship and last-handler bonuses make help compete with private delivery interests.
task.observation_access: Fixed wall layout and depot identities are public. Roles observe themselves, couriers within Manhattan distance 3, and active packets within distance 2 or in their own custody. Every hidden packet value, including position, destination, timer, carrier and sponsor, is zeroed behind an explicit visible bit. Reservation locations/timers and delivery/expiry radio receipts are public. Inactive reservation positions remain public historical signals. Private handoff/pickup flags are not declared global scene events. The diagnostic full-state view must be separately labelled.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public radio receipt for each packet newly delivered this step
Public radio receipt for each packet newly expired this step

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
